visualCharacteristics.purpose: Video beside a short marketing statement
visualCharacteristics.description: Two fixed side-by-side panels: playable video (poster + video link) and a text panel with eyebrow, statement and CTA
visualCharacteristics.source: Fixed pair of different content side by side that never wraps into a grid: playable video (poster + mp4 link) and a dark text panel with eyebrow, statement and CTA.

contentPattern.structure: One row, two cells. Cell 1: poster image plus a link to an .mp4 video. Cell 2: eyebrow paragraph, statement paragraph, CTA link
rows: Eyebrow 'Solutions For', paragraph 'OEMs | Distributors | Engineers | Professionals', CTA link 'Learn more'

reuseGuidance: Use when a video should sit beside text. Cells stack on mobile; the video loads only when the play button is clicked.
